title: CANONICAL turns scattered work into a reviewable operating loop.
summary: The system starts with real materials, messy notes, uploaded packages, and agent drafts, then converts them into classified records that can be reviewed, filed, and exported without losing rail separation.

workflow.title: Capture the work
workflow.text: Bring in material requests, class notes, package ZIPs, source docs, or generated drafts without pretending they are clean yet.

workflow.title: Normalize into structured outputs
workflow.text: Create briefs, packet outlines, docs, manifests, package summaries, and export previews from the selected program context.

workflow.title: Check boundaries before filing
workflow.text: Confirm ownership rail, visibility, evidence status, restricted content posture, and whether live connectors are allowed.

workflow.title: Attach the record to CANONICAL
workflow.text: Store approved metadata, summaries, manifests, and references so the app remains aligned with the durable file spine.

workflow.title: Prepare downstream adapters
workflow.text: Export only approved material to print, ZIP, Classroom, ClickUp, Dropbox, or public proof surfaces.

rails: AYA / CTS classroom and operational material stays institution-safe.
PRISM framework material stays private-first unless curated.
CANONICAL remains the spine that indexes, remembers, and routes the work.
